problem: Six pricing examples were labeled as the complete company situation selector while Powerhouse supports a richer multi-context model.
prevention: Pricing examples must be labeled as commercial routes rather than the complete company-context taxonomy.
The canonical phase, strategic-event and entrepreneur-goal taxonomy must remain explicit on pricing.
Regression tests must fail if the six commercial panels are relabeled as the complete company situation selector.

evidence.outcome: Commercial pricing routes are now clearly separated from the complete Portal/Powerhouse business context.

root_cause: The pricing page retained a legacy six-situation commercial selector label after Portal V2 moved to a multi-context model with independent phases, strategic events and goals.
